# Snacklist’s app icon without the hexagon (AI1–AI5)

<!-- Generated by tools/approaches.mjs from copy.js, options.js and measured.json. Do not edit. -->

One question: what is Snacklist’s app icon once the hexagons are gone (RD1, shipping behind `redesign-rd1`)? Five different answers in RD1’s colours and shapes (the production tokens), next to today’s icon. Every image on this page is drawn by the same generator that writes the app’s icon files, so what you see is what the build ships.

## Recommendation

**Pick AI1 Soft tile.** It is today’s icon with RD1’s one change: the hexagons become rounded rectangles. Everything else people know stays: cobalt, the honey ring, the white tile and the check. It is also sharper than today. Its thinnest part is 2.0 px at 29 pt against today’s 1.2 px, because the check has more room in a square than in a hexagon. The tinted and themed glyph (ring and check) keeps 2.0 px too. The art reaches 29.3 of the 33 dp the Android safe circle allows. The swap is the cheapest: the same layers, roles and Icon Composer groups as today.

**Runner-up: AI3 Bite.** It is the most distinctive mark and the clearest at every size (no part thinner than 9 px at 29 pt; 6.85:1 against cobalt). It drops the check, though, and starts a new motif (RD10’s bite) that the app itself does not use under RD1. Pick it if Snacklist should not look like a to-do app’s checkbox.

AI5 Big check is the boldest check, but its honey tile nearly vanishes on light wallpapers (1.10:1). AI2 The list shows the product best and fails at small sizes: its box outlines are 0.6 px at 29 pt. AI4 Bag is clear (1.9 px) but adds a third object that the app never shows.

## The options

- **Today Wabenstapel**: A honey hexagon ring on cobalt, a white hexagon inside it with a cobalt check.
- **AI1 Soft tile**: Today’s icon with RD1’s rounded rectangles in place of the hexagons: a honey tile ring, a white tile, the cobalt check. One shape swapped, the way RD1 swaps the app’s shapes.
- **AI2 The list**: Three RD1 list rows on the paper colour: the first ticked off in a honey box, two still open. It shows what the app is.
- **AI3 Bite**: A honey snack with a bite out of one corner, on cobalt: the “snack” in Snacklist, RD10’s motif. No check, no list.
- **AI4 Bag**: A tapered honey tote bag with a wide handle and today’s check on it, on cobalt.
- **AI5 Big check**: One heavy cobalt check on honey, nothing else. The colours swap places: honey becomes the tile.

## Measured

| Option | Thinnest part at 29 pt @1x / 48 px | Tinted/themed: thinnest at 29 pt | Main shape contrast, light / dark | Weakest touching edge, light / dark | Tile vs. light wallpaper | Android: reach / safe circle | Keeps from today |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Today Wabenstapel | 1.2 / 2.0 px | 1.8 px | 8.87 / 9.53 | 1.29 / 1.53 | 7.55 | 25.3 dp | – |
| AI1 Soft tile | 2.0 / 3.4 px | 2.0 px | 8.87 / 9.53 | 1.29 / 1.53 | 7.55 | 29.3 dp | Colours, check, the ring around a white tile |
| AI2 The list | 0.6 / 1.0 px | 0.6 px | 8.25 / 9.53 | 1.20 / 9.53 | 1.09 | 28.4 dp | Colours, check |
| AI3 Bite | 9.4 / 15.5 px | 9.4 px | 6.85 / 14.57 | 6.85 / 14.57 | 7.55 | 29.8 dp | Colours |
| AI4 Bag | 1.9 / 3.2 px | 1.9 px | 6.85 / 14.57 | 6.85 / 14.57 | 7.55 | 25.3 dp | Colours, check |
| AI5 Big check | 4.0 / 6.5 px | 4.0 px | 6.85 / 14.57 | 6.85 / 14.57 | 1.10 | 26.6 dp | Check, colours (swapped) |

**Thinnest part**: every fill of the icon (each colour, also the gaps a colour leaves between two shapes) gets a local thickness, the widest disc that fits and covers the pixel; the column shows the thinnest part with at least 120 pixels at 384 px, scaled to 29 pt at 1x (29 px) and to the 48 px launcher icon. Under 1.5 px a part blurs into its neighbours (red); 2 px and more stays a solid line (bold). At @3x (87 px) multiply by 3.

**Tinted/themed**: iOS tinted and Android themed icons draw only the one-colour glyph, so its thinnest part, glyph or gap, counts there. Their contrast is the system’s, the same for every option (tinted sample 10.4:1, Android themed 13.3:1 light / 9.9:1 dark).

**Main shape contrast**: the shape that carries the icon against what it sits on (WCAG ratio). **Weakest touching edge**: the lowest ratio of any two colours that touch; honey next to white is 1.29:1, they part by hue only, which is why that edge goes soft at small sizes and for colour-blind eyes. **Tile vs. light wallpaper**: the tile’s own colour against a light grey-blue wallpaper (#e9edf4); a honey or paper tile nearly vanishes on light wallpapers and needs its glyph to carry it. On dark wallpapers every option’s dark icon uses the app’s dark surface, as today.

**Android**: the adaptive icon’s art may reach 33 dp from the centre (the 66 dp safe circle of the 108 dp canvas, which a circle mask keeps whole); the column shows how far each option reaches and the share of that radius used.

## Open questions

- **AI-Q1: when the new icon ships.** The icon is part of the build, not a flag: everyone gets it with the build that carries it, while RD1 is still behind `redesign-rd1`. Default: swap it in the Dec 1 submission for everyone. A new icon at launch costs no one a habit, and the hexagon goes from the store listing on day one.

- **AI-Q2: the splash screen.** Today it shows the 6b hexagon mark. Default: the picked icon’s tile, rounded, on the surface colour. The generator already does this for every AI option.

- **AI-Q3: the in-app brand block, the web app’s icons, the email logo and the Alexa icons.** The generator writes these from the same art. Default: they change with the icon.

- **AI-Q4: the site.** `site/public/favicon.svg`, `favicon.png` and `apple-touch-icon.png` are copies the generator does not write. Default: copy them from `app/web/` in the same PR.

- **AI-Q5: store screenshots.** `marketing/store-screenshots/compose.mjs` flattens the Play icon on cobalt, and the frames carry the hexagon “Wabenband”. Default: Play takes `store/play-512.png` from the asset set. The frames follow in their own PR (RD-Q4).

- **AI-Q6: the dark icon’s tile.** Every option uses the app’s dark surface (#0b1024) behind honey, as today. Default: keep it. Cobalt would be the alternative, but it is the light icon’s colour.

- **AI-Q7: iOS 26 Clear.** This page approximates it (a frosted pane with the glyph in white). Icon Composer renders the real one from the layers. Default: check it on Peter’s iPhone in the first TestFlight build with the icon. There is no iPhone on the runner.

- **AI-Q8: a notification icon.** The app sends no push notifications today. Default: none. The one-colour glyph is ready if that changes.

## After the pick

Every option is an art module in `design/app-icon/art/`. `design/app-icon/build.mjs` draws whichever one it is given (today: `art/today.mjs`, byte for byte the files on main). The swap after the pick is to make the picked module the default and run `node design/app-icon/build.mjs`. It writes the iOS AppIcon set (light, dark, tinted), the Icon Composer bundle, Android’s adaptive foreground, background and monochrome with the legacy mipmaps, the splash screens, the web icons and the brand block. The lint gate’s `--check` keeps them in step. Each option’s full set, plus `store/app-store-1024.png` and `store/play-512.png`, is already in `docs/design/app-icon/ai/assets/<option>/`, laid out like the repo.
